title: imp/{site}/held/{head_id} payload
description: UPSERT payload of imp/{site}/held/{head_id}: the edits the server holds on the figure instead of replaying them (import.proto HELD), listed whole units at a time, oldest first. keep writes the listed edits now, as an answer's writes (above each facet's current version), each then a knowing edit; take drops them; the card then lists the next. A tombstone means none is held. Serialized, at most 6,295,941 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it. Server-owned: a Push of this key is REJECTED facet_key_not_user_owned.

rev.description: Opaque; changes when the listed edits change. An answer names it.

held.description: The held edits listed: whole units (one push's edits to a copy's head, status, collection and disposal are one unit), oldest first. At most 16.

key.description: The facet key the edit wrote.

payload.description: The edit's payload as JSON text (sync.proto rule 3); absent for a tombstone.

version.description: The held edit's version, in the full user-facet form <instant>#<counter>#<device> (sync.proto rule 5).

reason.description: Why it is held: late_after_knowing (HELD (i)), made_on_revised_result ((ii)), after_answer ((iii)) or past_retention ((iv)).

more.description: How many held edits of the figure the card does not list yet; absent when it lists them all.
